name: snoozeguard
description: SnoozeGuard — drowsiness detection (web, mobile, API, IoT)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @snoozeguard/shared && npm run build -w @snoozeguard/api && npm run build -w @snoozeguard/mqtt-bridge && npm run build -w @snoozeguard/web
scripts.verify: npm run build -w @snoozeguard/shared && npm run build -w @snoozeguard/api && npm run build -w @snoozeguard/mqtt-bridge && npm run build -w @snoozeguard/web && npm run lint -w @snoozeguard/mobile --if-present
